synopsis: OpenUSD is an open, domain-neutral format for complete 3D scenes and assets, including geometry, materials and hierarchy; for this heavy off-road program, it is considered at least as strategically important as OpenDRIVE [f13198, f13199, f9363, f13200]. The recommended division of labor is OpenDRIVE for structured haul roads, OpenUSD and OpenMATERIAL for scenes, and OpenSCENARIO exports where required, within a broader standards-based integration architecture [f13216, f15862]. OpenUSD and Omniverse can represent mines and construction sites, but combine an open standard with NVIDIA components and do not constitute a validation method; sensor-material semantics and simulator portability therefore need governance [f8610, f9167, f9168, f8611]. Procurement should require OpenUSD and other open-format exports, alongside ownership-change exit clauses, to mitigate supplier dependence [f8887, f16487]. CARLA and Isaac Sim offer OpenUSD-related capabilities, while manufacturers starting without virtual-testing capability must build OpenUSD and 3D-asset skills alongside the wider simulation and validation disciplines [f8467, f9011, f8479, f8773, f16522]. The standard is free, but the listed release status is only “ongoing,” rather than a dated release milestone [f9170, f9171].
